name: Bad Dürrheim (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bad Dürrheim (a white cross on red and a star over waves on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Dürrheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Dürrheim arms — cross and star over waves
